title: Cost fidelity as the standing Gate-1 test
note:
Is realized slippage what the harness assumed, per leg? This is what makes the ladder traversable for SLOW legs: a 1d leg can never establish expectancy on paper in usable time (23 of 52 legs are unbounded_no_closes), but cost fidelity converges in a handful of trades because it measures a per-trade quantity. Divergence demotes the leg AND invalidates its Stage-0 record, because the backtest assumed a cost the venue does not charge. Same unit as D3.
